techaviv-semperis:ashbyhq:a2f5691a-2f57-.descriptionHtml:
At Semperis, our mission is to be a Force for Good. Starting with being a great place to work. We believe that when people feel valued, supported, and empowered, they do their best work. That’s why we focus on creating an employee experience rooted in purpose, growth, and balance. Semperis has been recognized as one of America’s Fastest-Growing Cybersecurity Companies by the Inc. 5000, a DUNS 100 Top Startup to Work For, and a multi-year Inc. Best Workplace awardee.

About the Role

We're looking a Senior DevOps Engineer FedRAMP to work on the deployment, orchestration, and secure operations of our FedRAMP authorized identity and security products. This role will be working in a highly regulated federal environment with authorized identity and security products.

U.S. citizenship is required, and we can only consider candidates located in

  • Phoenix, AZ

  • Washington, D.C

  • Hoboken, NJ

  • Dallas, TX

What You’ll Do

  • Improve build/release pipelines and GitOps workflows across the FedRAMP boundary

  • Architect and operate Azure Government Cloud infrastructure using Terraform/Terragrunt

  • Manage AKS clusters with Istio, secure networking, WAF configurations, and Zero Trust models (PIM/RBAC)

  • Maintain compliant CI/CD pipelines, automation scripts, and documentation aligned with FedRAMP controls

  • Oversee observability systems (Open Telemetry, Azure Monitor, Prometheus/Grafana) and maintain SLAs, SLOs, and reliability practices

  • Manage logging, audit trails, and data indexing using OpenSearch per FedRAMP requirements

  • Support production environments, participate in on call rotation, and help with incident response and post incident analysis

  • Collaborate with Security/Compliance teams on POA&M work, annual assessments, and continuous monitoring

  • Interact with federal customers and auditors; research emerging technologies suitable for FedRAMP adoption

Who You Are:

A hands-on, deeply technical engineer who thrives in regulated environments, balances security with delivery, and enjoys being deep in architecture and implementation.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 5+ years DevOps/SRE experience

  • U.S. citizenship

  • Prior experience working in FedRAMP Moderate or High environments

  • Active security clearance or ability to obtain one

  • Strong understanding of FedRAMP, NIST 80053, and federal security controls

  • Hands-on with Terraform/Terragrunt, AKS, Helm, Istio, Argo CD, Azure DevOps

Preferred Qualifications :

  • Experience with Zero Trust architecture, PIM, RBAC

  • Strong scripting/automation in Bash, Python, or Go

  • Familiarity with Kafka, microservices, and distributed systems

  • Experience with Azure API Management, Logic Apps, Cosmos DB performance tuning

  • Largescale SaaS or regulated environment experience

Why Join Semperis?
You’ll be part of a global team on the front lines of cybersecurity innovation. At Semperis, we celebrate curiosity, integrity, and people who take initiative. If you’re someone who sees the glass as half full, embraces challenges as growth opportunities, and values a healthy balance between work and life—we’d love to meet you.

**Semperis maintains office locations in several cities across the globe. Candidates who reside within 45 miles of one of our offices—or where the job description specifies a required location—will follow our hybrid work model. This includes working onsite some days per week and remotely the remaining days.

Semperis is an equal opportunity employer and will not discriminate against an applicant or employee based on race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), age, physical or mental disability, veteran or military status, genetic information, citizenship, marital status, or any other legally recognized protected basis under federal, state, or local law. The information collected by the Semperis application is solely to determine suitability for employment, verify identity, and maintain employment statistics. 

 

Applicants with disabilities may be entitled to reasonable accommodation under the Americans with Disabilities Act and/or other applicable state or local laws. A reasonable accommodation is a change in the way things are normally done which will ensure an equal employment opportunity without imposing undue hardship on Semperis. Please inform Semperis representative Anna Taylor, Director of Global Recruiting, if you need assistance completing this application or to otherwise participate in the application process.

Snappy is looking for a hands-on Full Stack Team Lead to drive the engineering behind our Swag and Store products - high-scale, ux driven and core offerings at the heart of our platform and business. You’ll lead a talented team of 2-3 full-stack developers while actively contributing code, shaping architecture, and setting the technical and cultural tone for the team.

  • Lead and mentor two-three full stack engineers, setting the technical direction and helping them grow through a mix of guidance, reviews, and knowledge sharing.

You Have

  • Over 7 years of experience in software development.

  • 3+ years with Node.js and modern frameworks.

  • 3+ years with React or related frameworks.

  • 2+ years managing an engineering team.

  • Product-oriented and skilled in working closely with business, product, and customer-facing teams.

Snappy is the award-winning, all-in-one gifting company that spreads joy, shares gratitude, and takes the guesswork out of gifting.

Founded in 2015, Snappy was named one of Inc.’s fastest-growing companies in the Northeast in 2021, 2022, and 2023. Snappy is the trusted gifting and swag partner to over 43% of Fortune 100 companies as well as thousands of individuals who use Snappy for personal gifting. Snappy thrives on connecting people and cultivating meaningful relationships through the power of gratitude and gifting. Our recipient-picks experience ensures gift-givers send the perfect gift every time, for everyone, on every occasion.Snappy has been featured on Fortune’s "Best Small & Medium Workplaces," “Best Workplace for Millennials,” and “Best Workplace in Tech” lists.

Snappy's stance on diversity, equity and inclusion, its active focus on give-back programs, and its fundamental mission to spread joy through the power of gifting all lead the way in unlocking the power of human kindness at work.

techaviv-tremor-international:ashbyhq:bd.descriptionHtml:
Who is Nexxen?
Flexible advertising, unified by data. Nexxen empowers advertisers, agencies, publishers and broadcasters around the world to utilize data and advanced TV in the ways that are most meaningful to them. Our flexible and unified technology stack comprises a demand-side platform (“DSP”) and supply-side platform (“SSP”), with the Nexxen Data Platform at its core.

Why join the Nexxen team?
With a global footprint, you can be part of a team that is transforming advertising through our creative, flexible and unified solutions. Employees hustle, commit and dedicate themselves to pillars that make up the Nexxen Way – the 3Cs - Customer Centric, Curious Mindset, Collaborative with No Ego.

Important Notice from Nexxen: Your Safety Matters

At Nexxen, we care about the well-being of our current and future employees. We are aware of the growing number of online scams and fraudulent job postings, and we urge all job seekers to remain vigilant. Please be advised that Nexxen will never request payment (whether in cash, cryptocurrency, or any other form) as a condition of employment, offer positions that require you to invest in vague or dubious financial schemes, or promote roles that resemble get-rich-quick opportunities. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Nexxen or encounter a questionable job posting associated with our name, please contact us at infosec@nexxen.com to verify its legitimacy. Your trust is important to us. Stay safe and informed.

Nexxen Fraud Alert and Notice: Protect Yourself from Impersonation and Fraudulent Activity

What You’ll Do:

The Senior Sales Ops Analyst will be focused on building scalable processes and increasing operational efficiencies focused on our Sales Commission process. The ideal candidate is highly driven, analytical, organized, and passionate, with domain expertise in digital media/programmatic sales operations.

Each day can be different here at Nexxen, but some of the things you can expect to be doing daily are:

• Deliver accurate, timely commission calculations and manage end-to-end administration of global sales compensation plans

• You will be a key partner to Sales leadership, Sales Operations and Finance teams

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams in Sales, Finance, HR, and Sales Operations to align on plan inputs and ensure data integrity

• Troubleshoot and resolve comp discrepancies, disputes, or data issues with a solution-first mindset

• Calculate, validate, and process quarterly sales commission payouts; maintain audit trails, reconcile discrepancies, and ensure compliance with plan rules

• Help develop and implement sales commission policies and processes for our sales teams across all segments while building processes that scale as the company grows

• Provide clear and timely communication to sales teams on commission structures, attainment, and payments

• Overseeing reporting tools and managing ad-hoc reporting requests for the sales & marketing departments to analyze and monitor their performance at various levels

What Will I Bring?

• BA/BS Degree in Business (including management, finance, accounting or operations)

• A minimum of 5+ years of relevant experience required

• Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, lookups); Strong ability to enhance and create Excel based models.

• Some knowledge of compensation systems, preferably Xactly.

• Strong understanding of sales commission structures, quota-based incentives, and revenue crediting.

• Financial acumen with the ability to analyze complex data, identify trends, and explain implications with a focus on accuracy and attention to detail

• Strong verbal and written communication, time management, organizational as well as presentation skills • Ability to collaborate effectively with teams, manage multiple tasks proactively, and prioritize responsibilities to meet specific deadlines.

• Highly motivated and results driven self-starter, operating with a sense of urgency and values accountability

At Nexxen, we value our differences, varied experiences, and collective contribution. We know that not everyone takes the same career path, so if you don’t match this job description perfectly, don’t worry! We would rather see your application than risk missing out on your potential to make an impact.

In support of pay transparency and equity, the minimum and maximum full-time annual base salary for this role is $80,000 - $110,000 at the time of posting. While this is our reasonable expectation this is not a guarantee of compensation or salary, actual compensation is influenced by a wide range of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, education, certifications, responsibility, and geographic location. Candidates hired to work in other locations will be subject to the pay range associated with that location. We offer a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, disability insurance, 401(k), EAP, parental leave, unlimited vacation, and company-paid holidays. The specific programs and options available will vary depending on the state, start date, and employment type. Our Talent Acquisition team will be happy to answer any questions you may have.

tidemarkcap-jane-app:ashbyhq:4fa9fad2-fe.descriptionHtml:
About The Role

Hi, I'm Colin Sproule, a Senior Design Manager at Jane. I've been here for three years, and I get to work alongside an incredibly thoughtful group of designers who care deeply about creating intuitive and delightful experiences.

Our Design team exists to help practitioners focus on what they love most - helping their clients - by removing friction and making complex work feel simple. On the JaneX team, that mission shows up in one of the most consequential spaces in our product: the full clinical encounter. We own everything a practitioner does before, during, and after a patient visit - chart entries, templates, treatment plans, supervision, private notes, and AI Scribe. The complete arc of how a practitioner captures and delivers their clinical work.

On a more personal note, I live on BC’s upper Sunshine Coast. When I’m not thinking about design, you’ll usually find me biking, making experimental music, playing tabletop games, or reading small-press comics. If you’re curious to learn more about my background, you can find me on LinkedIn here: https://www.linkedin.com/in/cawlin/

JaneX is an ambitious, diverse team with a real track record of innovation. We brought Jane's first AI feature - AI Scribe - to general market, and we're just getting started. The work you do will directly shape how practitioners document care, how confident they feel doing it, and whether the tools we build make their hardest days a little easier.

What Impact We're Looking For You To Make

  • Design documentation experiences that help practitioners stay focused on their patients - reducing friction across chart entries, templates, treatment plans, and AI-assisted workflows so that the clinical encounter feels effortless and human.

  • Advocate for customers by grounding every decision in thoughtful research, clearly representing practitioner needs, and keeping the team focused on solving real problems rather than shipping features.

  • Lead with clarity by aligning stakeholders, communicating the reasoning behind your work, and using strong storytelling to bring cross-functional teams along on the journey from problem to solution.

  • Deliver consistently high-quality design outcomes by iterating on real-world usage, holding a high bar for craft, and building experiences that earn trust and create genuine delight over time.

What Experience We Need

  • 5+ years of product design experience in a SaaS or similar environment, with a portfolio that demonstrates clarity, craft, and intentional decision-making across complex workflows.

  • Proven experience designing AI-powered experiences that feel trustworthy, transparent, and human-centered - you understand how to make intelligent features feel approachable, not intimidating.

  • Strong systems thinking skills with a track record of designing across interconnected workflows, not just isolated screens or features.

  • Experience leading user research and translating insights into product decisions that drive measurable improvements in outcomes and experience quality.

  • Fluency with modern design tools and a comfort working in iterative, collaborative environments where things move fast and the problems are rarely fully defined.

If you don't meet every single qualification but are excited about this role, we'd still love to hear from you.

Compensation & Benefits

At Jane, we’re committed to paying fairly, clearly, and above all, paying for growth. This role has an annual salary range of $115,200 to $180,000. While that is a large range, it is intentional. It reflects the full growth journey someone might take in the role, from developing skills early on to becoming highly proficient and ultimately achieving excellence.

Most new hires join at the accomplished stage, which for this role represents an annual salary of $136,800. A starting salary below this typically indicates a candidate with strong potential who is still developing key skills. Salaries above this usually apply to existing team members who have made a significant impact and bring deep Jane-specific knowledge.

We believe in paying for growth. You’ll have regular career development conversations with your manager and your compensation will grow as you gain experience and contribute meaningfully to our mission.

Paying clearly is one of our compensation fundamentals. Watch this short video to learn how our salary bands are set. You’re also encouraged to ask questions about compensation at any point during the interview process.

We also offer a comprehensive benefits package. You can learn more about it here!
